audited_claims.claim: OpenAI closed $122B in committed capital at a $852B post-money valuation.
Anthropic raised $65B in Series H at a $965B post-money valuation.
OpenAI and NVIDIA announced at least 10 GW of NVIDIA systems.
Anthropic announced up to 5 GW of AWS capacity and more than $100B over ten years.
Cerebras disclosed 750 MW of committed OpenAI capacity in a deal valued above $20B.
Microsoft disclosed an approximately $135B OpenAI investment representing roughly 27 percent.

gemini_critique_assessment.central_financial_and_compute_claims: The critique is factually incorrect on the named examples.
gemini_critique_assessment.likely_failure_mode: The reviewer appears to have treated current 2026 official disclosures as hypothetical or evaluated them against an older information baseline.

real_issues_found_in_v0_1.issue: The Google/Broadcom to Anthropic edge used an exact 5 GW figure while its attached dedicated source said only multiple gigawatts.
real_issues_found_in_v0_1.resolution: Changed the value to multiple GW and marked the exact quantity as undisclosed.

real_issues_found_in_v0_1.issue: The Cerebras edge cited the 10-Q for both capacity and deal value, although the more-than-$20B wording is clearest in the filed 8-K results release.
real_issues_found_in_v0_1.resolution: Added the 8-K source and linked both filings to the edge.

real_issues_found_in_v0_1.issue: Private-company valuations could distract from the sovereignty analysis even though they were excluded from node sizing.
real_issues_found_in_v0_1.resolution: Kept them as verified dated context, but disabled their rendering by default.
